picks.name: Heroic Aura
picks.annotation: Fire rate for turrets. Indespensible for wall max 1st or turrets during MIDBOSS or BASE DEFENSE. Remember to spread turrets the AoE for Heroic is decently big.

picks.name: Monster Rounds
picks.annotation: PUSH WAVE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE.

picks.name: Intensifying Magazine
picks.annotation: Buy if you think that you can get away with gun in the lane. Your goal when you buy this is you will shoot the enemy a lot with your gun + take guardian faster after 5 min.

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: anti heal late game + resist, if nobody else has this you should buy this.

picks.name: Healing Tempo
picks.annotation: Buy this to ultra buff turret fire rate especially in areas like Midboss or other areas where you have setup turrets. Healing Nova can also apply Tempo to turrets instead of your Specter.

picks.name: Enchanter's Emblem
picks.annotation: S tier item this patch because spirit damage is META. This provides offensive and defensive bonuses the best of both worlds + CDR.

picks.name: Indomitable
picks.annotation: This will basically make you immortal during your ult vs stuns (if no unstop). It is hard to justify buying both this and Unstop. If Lash ults ults/Haze sleeps or Abrams ult, it activates before stun.

picks.name: Unstoppable
picks.annotation: Buy when enemies keep stunning you out of your ult. ALWAYS use unstoppable before ulting. Sometimes use METAL SKIN before ulting too. Pairs well w/ sup duration.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.

picks.name: Refresher
picks.annotation: Buy when you have placed all your turrets/heal and YOU are about to end the game. Place another batch of turrets and another ultimate. Good for base defense or sieges after using up all cooldowns

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: Escalating is better than Boundless after exactly 4.23s of gaining stacks (6 stacks) without any time lag inbetween. Boundless for this test had Mystic Vuln while Escalating had Improved Spirit.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: This is the 2nd best power increase you can buy in the game while Escalating Exposure is the 1st for 6400 items. Remember that you will get 15% spirit power so make sure you do your SINNERS/STATUE-MAX

picks.name: Superior Duration
picks.annotation: Buy this generally to make items like Unstoppable last longer so that you have more ult uptime.

picks.name: Lightning Scroll
picks.annotation: Buy ONLY if enemies have channeled spells like Dynamo Ult, Haze ult, Mo&K Ult, Seven Ult (before he ults) etc.. This item becomes less worth it the higher rank you get (I don't buy it at all in Eter5)

picks.name: Arcane Surge
picks.annotation: Arcane Surge before using Ult and Heal (if maxed, otherwise don't bother) and late game for turrets, especially effective during base defense or base sieges.

picks.annotation: Buy this when nobody on your team has Healbane and you desperately need anti-heal. Turrets and ult even wall can apply this.
